purpose: Source-referenced neutral hydrogen ground-state hyperfine 21 cm transition target for future hyperfine Hamiltonian artifacts.

recommended_transition.source_note: Compilation recommends the final value 1420.405751768 MHz for the hydrogen ground-state hyperfine transition.
